final_answer.key_evidence_summary: All 11 boutique pods are 2/2 Running with 0 restarts, so the fault is not workload-level. Frontend error log (199/6079) shows POST /cart/checkout returning 500 with 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Cannot read properties of null (reading credit_card_number)'; paymentservice logs the identical TypeError 199 times (ratio 8.92%) while checkoutservice error logs are clean (malformed-request trail sits in the callee). Defect line found in checkoutservice main.go chargeCard(): 'paymentInfo = nil' is executed before building pb.ChargeRequest{CreditCard: paymentInfo}, blanking the required credit_card field before the outgoing RPC — the request field is emptied before it goes to work and the downstream error echoes that empty field, which per the code-class rule is code_missing_parameter. Paymentservice charge.js is stock code and reads request.credit_card correctly (proto keepCase:true), and GetAppYAML(checkoutservice) shows PAYMENT_SERVICE_ADDR=paymentservice:50051 (address correct, ruling out addressing faults); the workload carrying the defect uses the custom image wangyl2128/checkoutservice-v2:latest versus the upstream paymentservice:v0.10.3. The emailservice AVAILABILITY_MISSING / 'success_rate vanished' alert is a consequence, not the cause: its Service exists and its endpoint is bound (172.20.2.17:8080), but checkout aborts at payment so the email step is never reached. Namespace events show no persistent scheduling/mount/image-pull/probe mechanism (only self-healed rollout history), confirming an application-level code mechanism.
